rule.statement: A party cannot challenge the antecedent validity of a writ of execution by invoking the inherent powers of the court under Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code and Section 328.
rule.supporting_quote: Invoking the inherent powers of court under Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code and Section 328 was not open to him.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code and Section 328
